blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 (Thermoregulation and Osmoregulation) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Homeostasis keeps the internal environment stable. (i) Define homeostasis and name its important processes. (ii) Explain how the control centre and effectors keep the internal environment at its set points, with an example. (4 marks)
(Homeostasis andaruni mahaul ko mustaqil rakhta hai. (i) Homeostasis ki definition likhein aur is ke ahem processes ke naam likhein. (ii) Misaal ke saath wazahat karein ke control centre aur effectors andaruni mahaul ko set points par kaise rakhte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) (1 number) Homeostasis woh zaroori amal hai jis se jandar bairooni tabdeeli ke bawajood mustaqil andaruni mahaul rakhte hain. Is ke ahem processes thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion hain.

(ii) (3 number)
Control centre: yeh receptors se maloomat leta hai, us par amal karta hai aur effectors ko munasib paigham bhejta hai. Yeh paigham andaruni mahaul ko set points ki tang hadd mein rakhte hain jo jism ke kaam ke liye behtareen hain. Dimagh, spinal cord aur endocrine glands control centres hain.
Effectors: jism ke woh hisse jo control centre ke paigham par jawab dete hain. Muscles sukar kar aur glands ratoobat kharij kar ke jawab dete hain; is tarah woh andaruni mahaul ko set points par wapas laate hain.
Misaal: jab temperature set point se gir jaye to jild aur muscles ke effectors shivering aur vasoconstriction karte hain. Is se heat zyada banti hai aur temperature wapas set point tak aata hai.

book_ref.quote: These messages ensure that the internal environment remains within a narrow range of set points

blocks.prompt:
2 Define a negative feedback system. Explain how it regulates body temperature when it rises above 37°C. (4 marks)
(Negative feedback system ki definition likhein. Wazahat karein ke jab jism ka temperature 37°C se barh jaye to yeh use kaise control karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Negative feedback: woh mechanism jis mein system ki paidawar system ki sargarmi kam karti hai. Yeh regulation ki sab se aam shakal hai; misalein jism ka temperature, blood glucose aur hormones ke ikhraj ka control hain.

Temperature ka control:
1. Jism ka temperature 37°C ke set point se barh jata hai.
2. Dimagh ke hypothalamus ke thermoreceptors yeh tabdeeli pehchante hain.
3. Woh control centre, yani hypothalamus ke thermoregulator, ko signal bhejte hain.
4. Control centre effectors, jaise sweat glands, ko paigham bhejta hai.
5. Effectors paseena banate hain jo temperature kam karta hai.
6. Paidawar (set point tak kam temperature) thermoreceptors par manfi asar dalti hai, is liye woh control centre ko paigham bhejna band kar dete hain aur response ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The output of this process (lowering of temperature to the set point) influences the thermoreceptors negatively

blocks.prompt:
3 Positive feedback works in the opposite direction to negative feedback. (i) Explain the positive feedback loop of childbirth. (ii) How can unregulated positive feedback cause health problems? (4 marks)
(Positive feedback negative feedback ke ulat kaam karta hai. (i) Paidaish ke positive feedback loop ki wazahat karein. (ii) Be-qaboo positive feedback sehat ke masail kaise paida kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) (3 number) Positive feedback mein paidawar system ki sargarmi barhati hai aur asal stimulus ko taqwiyat deti hai. Yeh negative feedback se kam aam hai aur un processes mein hota hai jin mein tez aur bari tabdeeli chahiye, jaise khoon jamna, dard-e-zeh aur paidaish.
Paidaish:
1. Uterus ke sukarne control centre (hypothalamus ka hissa) ko nerve impulses bhejte hain.
2. Control centre pituitary gland ko oxytocin kharij karne ka signal deta hai.
3. Oxytocin uterus ke mazeed sukarne ko ubharta hai.
4. Yeh hypothalamus ko mazeed impulses bhejte hain aur mazeed oxytocin kharij hota hai.
5. Yeh loop bachcha paida hone tak chalta hai.

(ii) (1 number) Shadeed sozish ya infection mein immune cells cytokines naam ke proteins kharij karte hain jo immune response ko mazeed ubharte hain. Agar yeh positive feedback theek control na ho to zyada sozish aur tissue ka nuqsan hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxytocin then stimulates further contractions of the uterus

blocks.prompt:
4 Osmoregulation and osmoconformers. (i) Define osmoregulation and state why it is essential. (ii) Explain why osmoconformers are found mainly in marine water, giving examples. (4 marks)
(Osmoregulation aur osmoconformers. (i) Osmoregulation ki definition likhein aur batayein ke yeh kyun zaroori hai. (ii) Wazahat karein ke osmoconformers zyada tar samundar mein kyun milte hain, misaalon ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) (2 number) Osmoregulation jism ki raton mein paani aur solutes ka tawazun rakhna hai. Yeh yaqeeni banata hai ke jism ki ratoobat bohat patli ya bohat gaarhi na ho. Yeh bohat se physiological processes ke liye zaroori hai, jaise sahi blood pressure, organs ka theek kaam aur metabolism ka nizam.

(ii) (2 number) Osmoconformers apni jism ki raton ki osmotic miqdar ko mahaul ke mutabiq hone dete hain. Woh apne jism mein paani aur solutes ki miqdar qaim nahi rakh sakte, is liye yeh medium ke saath badalti hai aur woh us ke isotonic rehte hain. Aise janwar sirf wahan reh sakte hain jahan solutes ki miqdar nisbatan mustaqil ho, jaise samundar. Misalein: tamam samundari invertebrates, kuch meethe paani ke invertebrates, aur kuch samundari vertebrates jaise hag fishes, sharks aur rays.

book_ref.quote: Osmoconformers are the animals which allow the osmotic concentrations of their body fluids to match their environment

blocks.prompt:
5 Compare the osmotic problems of freshwater animals and hypotonic marine animals, and the methods each uses to solve them. (4 marks)
(Meethe paani ke janwaron aur hypotonic samundari janwaron ke osmotic masail aur un ke hal ke tareeqon ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Meethe paani ke janwar aam tor par ird gird ke paani ke hypertonic hain, jabke hypotonic samundari janwar aise paani mein rehte hain jis mein un ke tissues se kahin zyada namak hai. Is liye in ke masail ulte hain aur hal bhi:

book_ref.quote: To compensate for the water loss, marine animals drink seawater continuously

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai 'most marine animals are hypotonic', magar usi chapter ke mutabiq tamam samundari invertebrates osmoconformers (isotonic) hain. Is liye yeh muqabla sirf un samundari janwaron ka hai jo samundar se hypotonic hain, jaise samundari machhliyan.

blocks.prompt:
6 Terrestrial animals constantly lose water. Describe their anatomical, physiological and behavioural adaptations for maintaining osmotic balance. (4 marks)
(Khushki ke janwar musalsal paani khote hain. Osmotic tawazun rakhne ke liye un ki anatomical, physiological aur behavioural adaptations bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Masla: khushki ke janwar saans ki satahon se bukharat, jild aur waste ke ikhraj se paani khote hain. Paani ka hasool (peena aur khana) aur metabolic water nuqsan ke barabar hona chahiye.

Anatomical adaptations: nisbatan na-nufooz pazeer bahar ki tahein bukharat rokti hain:
• insects: chitin ka waxy exoskeleton;
• reptiles: keratin ke waterproof scales;
• mammals aur parinde: murda keratinized skin cells aur jild mein tel ke glands.

Physiological adaptations: kidneys paani rokne mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain. Protein metabolism ka bunyadi waste ammonia urea ya uric acid mein badalta hai jo ikhraj ke liye kam paani lete hain. Kuch janwar, jaise Kangaroo Rat, sirf cellular respiration ke metabolic water par zinda rehte hain.

Behavioural adaptations: bohat se sehrai janwar din ki garmi mein zameen ke andar rehte hain aur sirf raat ko nikalte hain jab hawa thandi aur nam ho. Woh carbohydrate se bhare sehrai paudon ke beej khate hain.

Anhydrobiosis: tardigrades jaise kuch invertebrates taqreeban saara paani kho kar ghunoodgi mein chale jate hain aur saalon baad paani milne par wapas zinda ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: These animals have anatomical, physiological, and behavioral adaptations to maintain osmotic balance

blocks.prompt:
7 Compare ammonia, urea and uric acid as nitrogenous wastes with respect to toxicity, water needed, site or cost of formation and the animals that excrete them. (4 marks)
(Ammonia, urea aur uric acid ka nitrogenous wastes ke tor par muqabla karein: zehreelapan, darkar paani, banne ki jagah ya qeemat, aur kharij karne wale janwar.)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se janwaron mein osmoregulation nitrogenous wastes ke ikhraj se jura hai jo paani mein ghul kar kharij hote hain; mukhtalif mahaul ke janwar mukhtalif shaklein kharij karte hain:

blocks.prompt:
8 Nitrogenous wastes are changed on land. (i) Why do terrestrial animals convert ammonia into urea or uric acid instead of excreting it directly? (ii) Explain the formation of uric acid in humans and how its excess causes gout. (4 marks)
(Khushki par nitrogenous wastes badle jate hain. (i) Khushki ke janwar ammonia ko seedha kharij karne ke bajaye urea ya uric acid mein kyun badalte hain? (ii) Insaanon mein uric acid ke banne aur us ki ziyadti se gout hone ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) (2 number) Ammonia bohat zehreeli hai aur aik gram ko be-zarar karne ke liye 500 mL paani chahiye; yeh sirf meethe paani ke janwar kar sakte hain. Khushki ke janwaron ko paani bachana hai, is liye woh liver mein ammonia ko urea banate hain (kam zehreela, fi gram 50 mL paani) aur kidneys se kharij karte hain. Insects, sehrai janwar, parinde aur aksar reptiles khushk mahaul mein paani ke shadeed masle se urea bhi afford nahi kar sakte; woh bohat energy laga kar uric acid banate hain jo aur bhi kam zehreela, kam hal pazeer hai, tah-nasheen banata hai aur fi gram sirf 1 mL paani leta hai.

(ii) (2 number) Insaan bhi peshab mein thora uric acid kharij karte hain. Yeh purines ke tootne ki zimni paidawar hai jo bohat si ghizaon, khaas tor par gosht aur kuch sabziyon mein hoti hain, aur liver mein banta hai. Sehatmand logon mein zyada tar uric acid peshab mein nikal jata hai. Jab khoon mein uric acid zyada ho to joron aur tissues mein uric acid ke crystals bante hain aur dardnak bimari gout (naqras) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Humans also excrete a small amount of uric acid in urine

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain how ectotherms regulate their body temperature by behaviour, and why their low metabolic rate makes this necessary. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke ectotherms rawaiye ke zariye apna temperature kaise control karte hain, aur un ka kam metabolic rate ise kyun zaroori banata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Ectotherms: woh janwar jo zyada tar heat bairooni zaraye se lete hain; un ka andaruni temperature aam tor par mahaul ke saath badalta hai. Aksar invertebrates, aur vertebrates mein machhliyan, amphibians aur reptiles, ectotherms hain.

Rawaiye ki zaroorat kyun: ectotherms ka metabolic rate bohat kam hai. Woh temperature barhane aur qaim rakhne ke liye kaafi heat nahi bana sakte, is liye mahaul ki heat par inhisar karte hain.

Rawaiyati thermoregulation:
• Bohat sardi: dhoop senkte hain (radiation se heat) ya garam chattan par baithte hain (conduction se heat).
• Bohat garmi: saaya dhoondte hain ya thandi zameen mein bil banate hain.
• Bohat thande ilaqon mein sab se thande mahinon mein ghunoodgi (dormancy) mein chale jate hain.

book_ref.quote: If they are too hot, they seek shade or burrow into the cool earth

blocks.prompt:
10 A lizard is called both an ectotherm and a poikilotherm, while a bird is both an endotherm and a homeotherm. (i) Explain the basis of each pair of terms. (ii) State one advantage of being a poikilotherm. (4 marks)
(Chhipkali ko ectotherm aur poikilotherm dono kehte hain, jabke parinde ko endotherm aur homeotherm dono. (i) Har jore ki bunyad ki wazahat karein. (ii) Poikilotherm hone ka aik faida batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) (3 number) Janwaron ki darja bandi do tarah hai:
• Heat ke zariye ki bunyad par: ectotherms zyada heat bairooni zaraye se lete hain (machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles jaise chhipkali); endotherms zyada heat andaruni metabolism se banate hain (parinde aur mammals).
• Thermoregulation ki salahiyat ki bunyad par: poikilotherms temperature tang hadd mein nahi rakh sakte aur woh aam tor par mahaul jaisa hota hai (tamam invertebrates, aur machhliyan, amphibians aur reptiles); homeotherms mahaul se qata nazar nisbatan mustaqil temperature rakhte hain, 'thermostats' (dimagh ka hypothalamus) se (mammals aur parinde).
Is liye chhipkali, jo heat bahar se leti hai aur jis ka temperature mahaul ke saath chalta hai, ectotherm aur poikilotherm hai; parinda, jo apni heat banata aur temperature mustaqil rakhta hai, endotherm aur homeotherm hai.

(ii) (1 number) Poikilotherms ko mustaqil temperature ke 'indhan' ke liye bohat khana nahi chahiye, is liye woh kam ghizaiyat wale mahaul mein zinda reh sakte hain jahan homeotherm bhooka mar jaye.

book_ref.quote: Their body temperature varies considerably, usually matching the temperature of environment

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe how endotherms produce and retain body heat, and how homeotherms keep their body temperature constant. (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke endotherms jism ki heat kaise banate aur rokte hain, aur homeotherms apna temperature mustaqil kaise rakhte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Endotherms:
• Woh zyada tar heat andaruni metabolism se banate hain.
• Nisbatan mustaqil temperature rakhte hain, aksar mahaul se zyada.
• Sardi mein kanpte hain (muscles ka sukarna) ya brown adipose tissue jala kar heat banate hain.
• Aksar mein heat rokne ki insulation hai, jaise baal, par ya charbi.
• Misalein: parinde aur mammals.

Homeotherms:
• Mahaul ki tabdeeli se qata nazar nisbatan mustaqil andaruni temperature rakhte hain.
• Dimagh ke hypothalamus ko 'thermostat' bana kar thanda ya garam karne ke responses shuru karte hain.
• Misalein: mammals aur parinde; insaan bohat thande ya bohat garam mahaul mein bhi taqreeban 37°C rakhte hain.
• Insaan endothermic homeotherms hain aur negative feedback se temperature control karte hain: jild ke thermoreceptors hypothalamus (jis mein bhi thermoreceptors hain) ko signal dete hain aur woh muscles aur glands ko islahi responses ka signal deta hai.

book_ref.quote: These animals maintain relatively constant internal body temperatures, regardless of environmental fluctuations

blocks.prompt:
12 Compare the responses of the human body to cooling (hypothermia) and to overheating (hyperthermia), stating how each response works. (4 marks)
(Insaani jism ke thand (hypothermia) aur garmi (hyperthermia) ke responses ka muqabla karein aur batayein ke har response kaise kaam karta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Dono soorton mein thermoreceptors ki khabar par hypothalamus muscles aur glands ko signal deta hai; responses ulte hain. Thermoreceptors dimagh ke aala marakiz ko bhi ubharte hain, is liye hum garmi ya sardi mehsoos kar ke naha lena ya pankha heater chalana jaise iqdamat kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: When body temperature rises above 37°C (hyperthermia), vasodilation occurs

rows: Vasoconstriction: jild ko kam khoon, is liye khoon se kam heat zaya
Vasodilation: epidermis ke neeche ki khoon ki capillaries phailti hain, epidermis ke neeche zyada khoon aur zyada heat ka ikhraj
Shivering (skeletal muscles ka jhatkedar sukarna) heat banata hai
Paseena: paseene ka urna heat le jata aur jism thanda karta hai
Rongte khare: baalon ki jar ke chhote muscles sukarte hain; khare baalon mein phansi hawa insulator
Metabolic rate barhta hai aur heat banti hai
Thyroid thyroxine kam kar sakta hai, basal metabolic rate aur andaruni heat kam
